endianness: little-endian; earliest element occupies lowest bits/bytes
BF16_FP32_rows: Row-major; each row begins on a 16-byte boundary; logical dimensions and physical row stride are separate descriptor fields.
padding: Padding elements are zero initialized and never included in mathematical reductions. BF16 row stride rounds up to 8 elements; FP32 row stride rounds up to 4 elements.
W4_projection: Output-major rows, K increasing; 128 K codes per row=64 bytes; first code in low nibble, second in high nibble; signed two-complement nibble; -8 rejected.
projection_scales: One FP32 scale per output for the resident K128 group, output order matching weight rows.
embedding_scales: 7 FP32 scales per hidden896 row, padded to 8 entries=32 bytes; padding is not a scale. Up to16 rows=512 bytes.
attention_score_probability: Physical row width1024 elements for SCORE/PROB; actual context L defines valid columns; padded columns are excluded from softmax/GEMM.
partial_assembly: Descriptor tracks tensor identity/shape/layout and covered semantic tiles. New outputs are invalid until successful completion; assembly destinations become valid only after all required tiles complete.
partial_sum: GEMM INIT starts from +0; ACCUM requires matching valid FP32 partial sum with expected next K group. Final tensor availability is distinct from valid partial-sum availability.
failed_commands: Invalidate any destination affected by a failed write; preserve source liveness; do not advance assembly coverage or expected K. No rollback of physical partial writes is assumed.
chunk_END: Preserve descriptors, coverage and partial sums on normal END/DONE.
ownership: Unchanged atomic exclusive bank acquisition, release by matching completion; legal partial assembly never bypasses ownership.
offset_rule: Compute commands use logical bank handles; LAYOUT may specify semantic row/column/head selection, not a raw byte offset. DMA addresses remain explicit.
limitations: Exact command bit fields, per-layout capability matrix and the full workload schedule remain pending. No HDL implemented.
